## Work item

<!--
Closes DEV-123          ← moves the item to QA Ready when this merges. Use it on exactly one PR.
Related to DEV-456      ← links in Jira, changes nothing. Use for items you only touched or mentioned.

UPPERCASE here, unlike the branch name. Jira's GitHub app matches a key in a branch either way,
but in a pull request description it only links an uppercase key.

Naming a key anywhere in this description attaches the PR to that item in Jira, so a PR that
merely mentions another ticket still shows up on it. Only a "Closes" / "Fixes" / "Resolves"
line moves anything — and not when it is inside `code` or a fenced block.

No work item? Say so here and add the `no-ticket` label, or name the branch without a key:
chore-… ci-… docs-… test-… refactor-… deps-… spike-….
-->
